messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up on the missing-spans postmortem. Link: <https://pm/internal/postmortems/msc-2026|missing-spans-2026>

Maya Chen: TL;DR: we need owners for three items: ETL mapping fix, aggregator dedup logic, automated span-loss alert + runbook. Proposed owners: @Raj, @Olivia, @Danielle.

Raj Patel: I can take the ETL mapping fix. Will open a PR by EOD Tue. SQL to reproduce sample trace loss:
```
SELECT trace_id, count(*) as span_count
FROM spans_raw
WHERE service = 'ingest' AND received_at >= '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY trace_id
HAVING count(*) < 3;
```

Olivia Gomez: I'll own the aggregator dedup path. ETA end of week. Will add unit tests + perf guardrails :hammer_and_wrench: 

Danielle Park: I'll own the automated alert + runbook. Suggest alert when span_loss_rate > 0.5% over 10m with automatic ticketing.

sre-bot: Created tickets: INC-4521 (ETL mapping) -> Raj Patel; INC-4522 (Aggregator dedup) -> Olivia Gomez; INC-4523 (Span-loss alert + runbook) -> Danielle Park. <https://tickets/internal/INC-4521|View INC-4521> :white_check_mark:

Raj Patel: Pushing a rollback-safe change. Will coordinate with @eng-oncall for canary window tomorrow morning.

Olivia Gomez: root cause is timestamp-flooring during rollup; patch will avoid floor() on merging step. Will run integration on staging.

Danielle Park: I'll add a Grafana panel and synthetic traffic test in CI. Need sample dataset to tune thresholds.

Raj Patel: Sharing sample now: s3://redwood-dev-play/missing-spans/samples/2026-03-22.tar.gz

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with assignees + deadlines and set a follow-up check-in next Tue 10:00am PT. @here ping if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
